address: 43 Fudong Street, East District, Tainan, Taiwan
bio: Light wood furnishings, arched windows and a crackle effect wall combine to create a relaxed, modern space. Run by a Tainanese catering group, this restaurant is aimed at omnivorous diners who wish to reduce their carbon footprint by forgoing meat once in a while. The lacto-ovo-vegetarian dishes are loaded with Asian spices and condiments, such as satay, Sichuan pepper and kimchi. Try the classic stir-fried king oyster mushroom with basil.
